chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Ubaydah, from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
The child of mulāʿanah is inherited by his mother with one-third, and the remainder belongs to the Imam of the Muslims.

key_terms.إِمَامِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Imam who holds authority over the Muslim community
key_terms.الْبَاقِي: the remainder of the inheritance after the assigned share
key_terms.اِبْنُ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ: the child related to a case of mutual imprecation/li'an

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance ruling for the child of mulāʿanah in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the inheritance of the child connected to li'an/mulāʿanah. It states that the mother receives one-third of his estate, while the remaining portion goes to the Imam of the Muslims.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5693 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Ubaydah, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said: "
The child of mula'anah is inherited by his mother with one-third, and the remainder belongs to the Imam of the Muslims."
